title: Crime & justice 2
note: B2 vocab leaf, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane. b1_crime (36) owns the everyday layer — burglary, robbery, murder, fraud, vandalism, police officer, suspect, witness, victim, judge, jury, arrest, court, trial, verdict, guilty, sentence, fine, punishment, appeal, legal, offence, convict — so this unit is the machinery underneath it: the named crimes a headline uses (manslaughter, blackmail, forgery, money laundering, perjury, accomplice), how a case is built (forensic, alibi, motive, interrogate, crime scene, fingerprint, testify, testimony, prosecution, defence, barrister, plead), and what happens after the verdict (conviction, acquittal, bail, parole, imprisonment, community service, offender, reoffend, rehabilitation, deterrent). SWEPT AGAINST A CORRECTED POOL: make_pool.py only counts live nodes, so it could not see the ten units this lane drafted today. The naive sweep returned custody and surveillance as clean; both are already taught, by leaf_relationships_b2 and leaf_news_b2 earlier today, and both were dropped. See the DECISIONS.md entry on pool blindness. All 36 words here are clean against live nodes AND against every drafted-but-not-live pack. C57 card 0 recaps Crime 1. C49 all 36 across three boards of 12. Build-the-family card is half recap: convict and offence are already the student's, and this unit adds conviction and offender; acquit -> acquittal and testify -> testimony run inside the unit. All four derived forms are bank items. A12 sense on defence (in court), since the sport/military reading is commoner. E10 Use is rewrite production; every underline reconstructs.

cards.title: You already know
cards.note: Crime 1 gave you the crimes people talk about — burglary, robbery, murder, fraud, vandalism — and the people in the room: police officer, suspect, witness, victim, judge, jury. It took you as far as the verdict. Those words come back in this unit's sentences. What is new here is everything either side of that: how a case is actually built, and what happens to a person afterwards.
cards.note_cz: Crime 1 ti dal trestné činy, o kterých se mluví — burglary, robbery, murder, fraud, vandalism — a lidi v místnosti: police officer, suspect, witness, victim, judge, jury. Dovedl tě k rozsudku. Ta slova se vracejí ve větách. Nové je tu všechno po obou stranách: jak se případ staví a co se s člověkem děje potom.

cards.title: Build the family
points: The first two you already know — here are the nouns built on them.

cards.title: You will use these words in

sentences.en: He was charged with assault after the fight.
sentences.cz: Po té rvačce byl obviněn z napadení.
accepts: He was charged with assault after the fight

sentences.en: The court found him guilty of manslaughter.
sentences.cz: Soud ho uznal vinným ze zabití.
accepts: The court found him guilty of manslaughter

sentences.en: Two men tried to kidnap the businessman.
sentences.cz: Dva muži se pokusili unést toho podnikatele.
accepts: Two men tried to kidnap the businessman

sentences.en: The family paid a large ransom for him.
sentences.cz: Rodina za něj zaplatila velké výkupné.
accepts: The family paid a large ransom for him

sentences.en: She went to the police about the blackmail.
sentences.cz: Kvůli tomu vydírání šla na policii.
accepts: She went to the police about the blackmail

sentences.en: The old picture turned out to be a forgery.
sentences.cz: Ukázalo se, že ten starý obraz je padělek.
accepts: The old picture turned out to be a forgery

sentences.en: Police found counterfeit notes in the car.
sentences.cz: Policie našla v autě padělané bankovky.
accepts: Police found counterfeit notes in the car

sentences.en: The bank was investigated for money laundering.
sentences.cz: Ta banka byla vyšetřována kvůli praní peněz.
accepts: The bank was investigated for money laundering

sentences.en: The trial was about drug trafficking.
sentences.cz: Ten proces byl o obchodování s drogami.
accepts: The trial was about drug trafficking

sentences.en: Perjury is a very serious offence.
sentences.cz: Křivá výpověď je velmi vážný trestný čin.
accepts: Perjury is a very serious offence

sentences.en: His accomplice waited in the car.
sentences.cz: Jeho spolupachatel čekal v autě.
accepts: His accomplice waited in the car

sentences.en: The perpetrator was never found by police.
sentences.cz: Pachatele policie nikdy nenašla.
accepts: The perpetrator was never found by police

sentences.en: Forensic tests showed he was in the room.
sentences.cz: Forenzní testy ukázaly, že byl v té místnosti.
accepts: Forensic tests showed he was in the room

sentences.en: The police checked his alibi very carefully.
sentences.cz: Policie si jeho alibi velmi pečlivě ověřila.
accepts: The police checked his alibi very carefully

sentences.en: The police could not find a motive.
sentences.cz: Policie nemohla najít motiv.
accepts: The police could not find a motive

sentences.en: They will interrogate the suspect this morning.
sentences.cz: Toho podezřelého budou vyslýchat dnes ráno.
accepts: They will interrogate the suspect this morning

sentences.en: The police closed the crime scene quickly.
sentences.cz: Policie místo činu rychle uzavřela.
accepts: The police closed the crime scene quickly

sentences.en: A single fingerprint was enough for the police.
sentences.cz: Jediný otisk prstu policii stačil.
accepts: A single fingerprint was enough for the police

sentences.en: She agreed to testify against her boss.
sentences.cz: Souhlasila, že bude svědčit proti svému šéfovi.
accepts: She agreed to testify against her boss

sentences.en: His words in court changed the jury's decision.
sentences.cz: Jeho slova u soudu změnila rozhodnutí poroty.
accepts: His words in court changed the jury's decision

sentences.en: The prosecution called three more witnesses.
sentences.cz: Obžaloba povolala další tři svědky.
accepts: The prosecution called three more witnesses

sentences.en: The defence asked for more time.
sentences.cz: Obhajoba požádala o víc času.
accepts: The defence asked for more time

sentences.en: Her barrister spoke for nearly an hour.
sentences.cz: Její advokát mluvil skoro hodinu.
accepts: Her barrister spoke for nearly an hour

sentences.en: He decided to plead guilty at the trial.
sentences.cz: Rozhodl se u soudu přiznat vinu.
accepts: He decided to plead guilty at the trial

sentences.en: The conviction was reported in every newspaper.
sentences.cz: O tom odsouzení psaly všechny noviny.
accepts: The conviction was reported in every newspaper

sentences.en: The jury decided to acquit both men.
sentences.cz: Porota rozhodla oba muže zprostit viny.
accepts: The jury decided to acquit both men

sentences.en: The acquittal surprised everyone in the court.
sentences.cz: To zproštění viny překvapilo všechny v soudní síni.
accepts: The acquittal surprised everyone in the court

sentences.en: The judge refused to give him bail.
sentences.cz: Soudce mu odmítl povolit kauci.
accepts: The judge refused to give him bail

sentences.en: He was released on parole after four years.
sentences.cz: Po čtyřech letech byl podmínečně propuštěn.
accepts: He was released on parole after four years

sentences.en: The sentence was five years imprisonment.
sentences.cz: Trest byl pět let odnětí svobody.
accepts: The sentence was five years imprisonment

sentences.en: She was given community service, not a fine.
sentences.cz: Dostala obecně prospěšné práce, ne pokutu.
accepts: She was given community service, not a fine

sentences.en: A young offender needs help, not punishment.
sentences.cz: Mladý pachatel potřebuje pomoc, ne trest.
accepts: A young offender needs help, not punishment

sentences.en: Most of them never reoffend after release.
sentences.cz: Většina z nich se po propuštění už nedopustí ničeho.
accepts: Most of them never reoffend after release

sentences.en: Rehabilitation works better than a long sentence.
sentences.cz: Náprava funguje líp než dlouhý trest.
accepts: Rehabilitation works better than a long sentence

sentences.en: A heavy fine works as a deterrent.
sentences.cz: Vysoká pokuta funguje jako odstrašující prostředek.
accepts: A heavy fine works as a deterrent

sentences.en: The magistrate listened to both sides carefully.
sentences.cz: Smírčí soudce si pečlivě vyslechl obě strany.
accepts: The magistrate listened to both sides carefully
